inputs.text: [excited] Seh… rat… oh… saurus. [curious] "Cerato," in Greek, means horn. [playful] And "saurus" means lizard. The horned lizard!
[amazed] A real horn, on its nose, like a rhino?
[happily] Exactly right, the horned lizard. It lived in North America, [confident] and maybe Europe too, in Portugal, [amazed] one hundred fifty million years ago.
[playful] Almost! [proud] The only big carnivore of its time with a horn on its nose.
